_comment: GENERATED-ADJACENT, HAND-EDITED ON PURPOSE. Every number here is a count of places a gate
looked at, could not decide about, and let through with a note. Each one is defensible on its
own — a body built at runtime genuinely cannot be read from source. Together they are a hole,
and the hole had no size, no date and no ceiling until this file existed (د-10).
THE RULE IS A RATCHET, AND IT IS STRICT IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. A count that RISES fails: the
unchecked set grew and nobody decided that. A count that FALLS also fails, and that is not
pedantry — a baseline that silently absorbs an improvement is a baseline that will silently
absorb a regression on the next line. Lowering the number is a one-line diff a person makes
while looking at what they just fixed.
TO CHANGE A NUMBER: fix the sites, run ci/check_the_unchecked_set_does_not_grow.py, and write
down what it tells you. Never the other way round.
